issues.description: Method Farm.addAnimal(Animal): the UML in problem_statement.md declares addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean (see problem_statement.md line 18) but the reference implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java implements addAnimal(Animal) with return type void (method signature at solution file line 23). The template (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) also does not provide a concrete signature and contains a TODO to implement Farm (template line 4), so students may be confused whether to implement addAnimal as boolean or void.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended return type consistent across artifacts. Option A (preferred if tests expect void): update the UML in problem_statement.md to show addAnimal(animal: Animal): void and adjust the textual task description to state the method returns void. Option B (if boolean is desired): change the template and solution to declare addAnimal(Animal): boolean and implement it to return animals.add(animal), and update any tests and examples accordingly. Also ensure the problem statement text explicitly documents the chosen return type so students implement the correct signature.
